name: China West Construction Group Co., Ltd
summary: China West Construction Group Co., Ltd (CWC Group), established in 2001 and headquartered in Chengdu, China, operates extensively in the building materials sector. Its reach extends across China and globally, with significant operations in countries like Algeria, Malaysia, Indonesia, and Cambodia. The company provides a comprehensive range of construction raw materials, including cement, admixtures, commercial mortar, sand, and various gravel aggregates. Beyond material supply, CWC Group is also involved in crucial supporting activities such as transportation pumping and rigorous scientific research and testing. Demonstrating a strong commitment to innovation, the company boasts an impressive R&D infrastructure. This includes a dedicated enterprise technology center for the ready-mixed concrete industry, a post-doctoral research station, two additional enterprise technology centers, and two engineering technology research centers.
